name: helm-core-docs
description: HELM Core documentation site (11ty + Tailwind + DaisyUI).

scripts.dev: node scripts/ensure-frames.js && bun run icons && concurrently -k "bun run css:watch" "eleventy --watch" "bun serve.js"
scripts.serve: bun run toolbox:build && node scripts/ensure-frames.js && bun run icons && bun run css:build && concurrently -k "eleventy --watch" "bun serve.js"
scripts.build: bun run toolbox:build && bun run site:build
scripts.site:build: cd .. && bun run content:check && cd docs && bun run icons && bun run css:build && eleventy
